toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: As-of 2026-10-24, using synthetic demonstration data for headset-stand with rule demo-direct. Target revenue margin 5% produces a recommended price of BRL 31.38 before discount. At 10% discount, charged price is BRL 28.24 and contribution turns negative.
assumptions: Synthetic demonstration product and rule were used and are labeled as such in provenance.
All charges in the pricing model use the same revenue basis in this demo: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
The product cost fixture includes material, energy, printer depreciation, maintenance, labor, packaging, and a failure-rate provision based on the stored demonstration assumptions.
Revenue margin is contribution divided by charged revenue; it is not markup. Markup on production cost is reported separately by the deterministic table.
limitations: Contribution is not net profit; unmodeled overhead remains outside this calculation.
Failure model uses the stored full-print retry provision from the demonstration fixture; actual retry behavior may differ.
No marketplace verification was performed; the channel rule is synthetic and not a current Shopee fee schedule.
